generation.scope: At an aligned finite mark the rank-one scheme in its four-dimensional matrix span has length at most four if finite. For length at most two the unique possible exceptional secant is rigid over Artin bases; at a curvilinear mark, or an embedding-dimension-two mark passing the tangent test, the induced map gives a scheme-wide opposite symmetry even with exceptional points elsewhere. A nonzero adjacent coordinate word has scheme support of length at least six.

open_mathematics: Treat the tangent exceptional secant at a planar mark, multiple secants, and the remaining marked four-planes and higher-rank and branching windows.
